title: Invest a $6 daily coffee for 30 years: $147,359
caption: $6 every workday = $1,560/yr. Invested at an assumed 7% average yearly return: about $21,554 after 10 years, $63,953 after 20, $147,359 after 30. What's your daily habit? Illustration only, returns not guaranteed. Not financial advice. #personalfinance #investing #compoundinterest #moneytips

title: $1,000,000 now or a penny that doubles for 30 days?
caption: 1¢ on day 1, doubling daily: $5.12 on day 10, $5,242.88 on day 20, $5,368,709.12 on day 30. That's compounding. A or B? (A math illustration; real investments don't double daily. Not financial advice.) #compoundinterest #math #personalfinance #moneytips

title: Is your savings account taking 72 years to double your money?
caption: Rule of 72: 72 ÷ interest rate ≈ years to double. 1% → about 72 years. 7% → about 10 years. $1,000 left for 72 years: $2,047 at 1% vs $130,506 at 7%. 7% is an assumed long-run stock average, not guaranteed; markets can drop. Not financial advice. #ruleof72 #investing #personalfinance #moneytips

title: $1,000 on a credit card at $25/month takes 82 months to pay off
caption: Example: $1,000 balance, 24% APR (2% a month), fixed $25 monthly payment, no new charges: 82 months (almost 7 years) and about $2,032 paid, $1,032 of it interest. At $50/month: 26 months, about $1,290. Your card's terms may differ. Not financial advice. #creditcard #debt #personalfinance #moneytips

title: $9.59 a day from age 15 could make you a millionaire by 60
caption: $3,500 a year ($9.59/day) from 15 to 60 at an assumed 7% return = $1,000,000. You put in $157,481; $842,519 is growth. Start at 35 and it's about $43.32/day. Not adjusted for inflation. Not financial advice. #investing #compoundinterest #personalfinance #millionaire

title: $10/month on skins, ages 13–23, invested instead = $20,266
caption: $10 a month for 10 years = $1,200. Invested at an assumed 7% average yearly return and left alone until 60 = about $20,266. Keep gaming, just know the trade-off. Under 18? You'll need a parent to open an investing account. Not financial advice. #gaming #personalfinance #investing #moneytips
